Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] forces invaded [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] and '''captured''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]]. This resulted in a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Battle of Rishi (Clone Wars)|countertattack]] which freed the planet.
